nodes.text: @Mellfrmdao @cristofaro689 @Kenneth_F13 No evidence supports a new deadly virus with 440 infections and nine deaths in China, or a CDC-confirmed U.S. case in April 2025. The claim likely refers to Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), a known seasonal virus, not a new threat. Check CDC or WHO for accurate updates.
